newsitem.title: USA: NYMEX to report Wilmington silver stocks weekly.
newsitem.headline: NYMEX to report Wilmington silver stocks weekly.

text.p: New York Mercantile Exchange (NYMEX) said it will report weekly both current and historical silver stock data from Wilmington Trust Co, Delaware, beginning this week.
The move comes in anticipation of Wilmington Trust becoming a licensed depositary for COMEX silver futures from Jan 1, 1997, the exchange said.
COMEX is a division of NYMEX.
Earlier Tuesday, COMEX told exchange floor traders that Wilmington Trust had 59,413,319 ounces of silver in deliverable form as of Sept 30.
Effective Jan 2, 1997, the exchange will begin reporting Wilmington Trust's eligible and registered silver stocks in the daily metal warehouse data.
